description: Execute the replica provision puppet command

replica.description: The name of the replica to provision

token_file.description: The name of the token-file for auth

legacy.description: Set to true if provisioning a replica for PE 2019.5 or older. Defaults to false

action.description: Non-legacy only. 'provision' runs provision without --enable, 'enable' runs enable replica, 'both' (default) runs the original atomic provision --enable.
